comment: Immutable build inputs for reproducible tollgate-wrt artifacts. Every byte-affecting external input is pinned here. Update intentionally (see docs/reproducible-builds.md); never point portal.commit at a floating ref.

go.comment: The toolchain that compiles the shipped binaries. Must equal the official golang of the pinned OpenWrt SDK release's packages feed (see .openwrt_sdk.go_per_release; scripts/sdk-go-version.sh check enforces it).

npm.comment: Bundled with node 22.17.0; verified at install time.

go_per_release._comment: Official Go toolchain of each OpenWrt release line, as shipped by that line's openwrt/packages feed (branch openwrt-<series>). scripts/sdk-go-version.sh check|update audits these against the live feed; the pinned .go.version must match the entry of the pinned .release's series. In-SDK Go builds on 23.05/24.10 additionally require src/go.mod's language minimum to be <= these versions (currently 1.25.0, so only 25.x qualifies).
